lead.headline: Stephen F. Austin goes 3-0 and covers all three
lead.deck: The Lumberjacks beat Indiana State, Temple and Utah Valley and are 6-1. Meanwhile McNeese, still first in the power rankings, lost by 26 at Texas State.
body: Stephen F. Austin had the best week in the Southland and it wasn't close. The Lumberjacks beat Indiana State 86-76 as 4-point favorites, beat Temple 72-70 as 2.5-point underdogs, then went to Utah Valley as 4-point favorites and won 77-72. Erik Makke scored 18, 22 and 21, with seven assists in the opener. At 6-1 the Lumberjacks own the league's best record.

McNeese is still first in the power rankings, but the week did the Cowboys no favors. They went to Texas State as 2-point underdogs and lost 95-69. Larry Johnson scored 29 and Elijah Moore 20, and nobody else got going. The Southland preseason poll made the defending champs the favorite. Our model has them third in the league, 127th nationally.

Lamar is the model's pick for the best team in the league, 110th nationally at plus-6.1 points per 100 possessions. The Cardinals lost 85-81 at home to Rice as 2-point underdogs, then beat Robert Morris 87-62 as 3-point underdogs. Quante Berry had 27 points and nine rebounds against Rice and 20 more against Robert Morris. Niccolo Moretti added eight assists in the win.

UTRGV climbed from seventh to fourth in the power rankings after a 79-73 win at Austin Peay as a 5.5-point underdog, with Caden Bell scoring 31. Houston Christian won 84-58 at UL Monroe as a 1.5-point favorite and is 5-1.
The league went 12-10 this week. Conference play opens Thursday with one game, UTRGV at Nicholls. Everybody else has one more week to find out who they are.

column.label: Look Ahead
column.title: Three road tests before the league starts
body: **McNeese at Louisiana, Saturday, 4 p.m.** No line posted yet. After a 26-point loss at Texas State, the Cowboys need a road win in-state to keep the top spot in the power rankings honest.
**UTRGV at UNLV, Saturday, 3 p.m.** The Vaqueros just won at Austin Peay. No line posted yet. This is a good look at whether Caden Bell's 31 was a night or a trend.
**Stephen F. Austin at SMU, Tuesday, 8 p.m.** No line posted yet. The league's hottest team has already beaten Temple as an underdog this week.

notes.headline: SE Louisiana won two on the road
notes.body: The Lions lost 96-59 at Kennesaw State, then won 70-60 at Northern Colorado as 2.5-point underdogs and 73-72 at North Dakota. Tyler Rolison scored 18, 26 and 22.

notes.headline: Incarnate Word nearly stole one in Honolulu
notes.body: The Cardinals were 17-point underdogs at Hawai'i and lost 83-81. They also beat Central Baptist 120-71.

notes.headline: Nicholls lost two at home
notes.body: The Colonels fell 80-69 to Southern Miss and 78-77 to Troy, where Donovan Oday scored 37. AJ Dent had 18 and 21.

notes.headline: Circle it: Stephen F. Austin at SMU
notes.body: Tuesday, 8 p.m. ET. The 6-1 Lumberjacks on the road. No line posted yet.
